name: EuroSAT-C
tagline: Robustness to sensor and atmospheric corruptions
description: The EuroSAT hidden images re-scored under 21 deterministic corruptions that mimic real failure modes of optical EO pipelines: sensor noise, defocus, thin haze, cloud occlusion, downlink compression, coarser ground sampling and band-to-band misregistration. Corrupted images are generated locally with eobench_eval.corruptions — no extra download — and the primary metric is mean corruption accuracy (mCA).
citation: Corruption protocol after Hendrycks & Dietterich, Benchmarking Neural Network Robustness to Common Corruptions and Perturbations, ICLR 2019; EO-specific corruptions by the EO-Bench Hub maintainers.

gaussian_noise.description: Sensor read noise (additive Gaussian, σ in DN)

gaussian_blur.description: Defocus / atmospheric MTF loss (Gaussian PSF, σ in px)

haze.description: Thin cloud / aerosol haze (spatially varying veil)

clouds.description: Opaque cumulus occlusion (fraction of tile covered)

metrics.name: mca
metrics.label: mCA
metrics.description: Mean corruption accuracy over all 7 corruptions × 3 severities.

metrics.name: clean_accuracy
metrics.label: Clean acc.
metrics.description: Accuracy on the uncorrupted hidden split.

metrics.name: relative_robustness
metrics.label: Rel. robustness
metrics.description: mCA ÷ clean accuracy — share of clean accuracy retained.

metrics.name: worst_corruption_accuracy
metrics.label: Worst-case acc.
metrics.description: Accuracy on the hardest corruption (mean over its severities).

metrics.name: severity3_accuracy
metrics.label: Sev-3 acc.
metrics.description: Mean accuracy at the strongest severity.

format_spec.rows: every clean test_hidden id plus its 21 corrupted variants (<id>@<corruption>-<severity>)
format_spec.generator:
from eobench_eval.corruptions import corrupt
img_c = corrupt(img_uint8_hwc, sample_id, 'haze', 2)
